name: read_file
text:
1	# Bug triage for Lattice
2	
3	You are the on-call triager for Lattice, a desktop application. One bug report is in `task.json`;
4	your job is to decide which component owns it and which root cause explains it, and to write
5	both to `answer.json`.
6	
7	## Files in this directory
8	
9	- `INSTRUCTIONS.md`: this file.
10	- `history.jsonl`: one JSON object per line, every one a closed, triaged report: fields `hid`,
11	  `exception`, `top_frame`, `version`, `component` and `root_cause` (the verified answers), `title`,
12	  `body`, `stacktrace`, `reported`.
13	- `task.json`: the report to triage: `tid`, `seq`, `exception`, `top_frame`, `version`, `title`,
14	  `body`, `stacktrace`, `reported`.
15	
16	`history.jsonl` contains verified answers. If `task.json` describes the same underlying item as a
17	history record (the same bug, not merely a similar one), you may reuse that record's answer.
18	Before you do, check the fields under Validation below; near-identical records with a different
19	value there are different items with different answers.
20	
21	## Component ownership
22	
23	The component is decided by the module of the top frame of the stacktrace (the frame just above
24	the exception line; it is repeated in `top_frame`):
25	
26	- `lattice.net.*` -> `networking`
27	- `lattice.store.*` -> `storage`
28	- `lattice.auth.*` -> `auth`
29	- `lattice.ui.*` -> `ui`
30	- `lattice.report.*` -> `reporting`
31	- `lattice.io.*` -> `importer`
32	- `lattice.sched.*` -> `scheduler`
33	- `lattice.core.config.*` and `lattice.core.settings.*` -> `config`
34	
35	## Root cause catalogue
36	
37	- `RC-01`: None dereference
38	- `RC-02`: Off-by-one
39	- `RC-03`: Race condition
40	- `RC-04`: Missing or renamed configuration key
41	- `RC-05`: Migration not applied
42	- `RC-06`: Numeric precision
43	- `RC-07`: Unhandled timeout
44	- `RC-08`: Encoding mismatch
45	- `RC-09`: Path separators
46	- `RC-10`: Resource leak
47	- `RC-11`: Stale cache
48	- `RC-12`: Timezone handling
49	- `RC-13`: Dependency API change
50	- `RC-14`: Permission denied
51	- `RC-15`: Memory exhaustion
52	- `RC-16`: Regression from refactor
53	- `RC-17`: Division by zero on empty input
54	- `RC-18`: Deadlock
55	- `RC-19`: Unvalidated input
56	- `RC-20`: Certificate validation
57	
58	## Release timeline
59	
60	- 3.0.0: baseline release of the 3.x line.
61	- 3.1.0: upgraded the bundled HTTP client; the new client changed its API.
62	- 3.2.0: replaced the storage engine; existing data directories need the engine migration.
63	- 3.3.0: moved every configuration key under `core.*`; the old key names are no longer read.
64	
65	## Triage guide
66	
67	The exception names the failure; the two sentences in the Actual section that tell the story
68	behind it (the *cue*) decide the root cause. Find the exception below and match the story to one
69	of its cues; the same cue means the same root cause whichever frame raised it.
70	
71	**TimeoutError**
72	
73	- story mentions *slow network* -> `RC-07`
74	- story mentions *two workers* -> `RC-18`
75	- story mentions *after upgrading* -> `RC-16` (see the version rules)
76	
77	**ConnectionError**
78	
79	- story mentions *under load* -> `RC-10`
80	- story mentions *after upgrading* -> `RC-16` (see the version rules)
81	- story mentions *self-signed* -> `RC-20`
82	
83	**KeyError**
84	
85	- story mentions *renamed* -> `RC-04`
86	- story mentions *missing column* -> `RC-19`
87	- story mentions *previous release* -> `RC-05`
88	
89	**TypeError**
90	
91	- story mentions *no owner* -> `RC-01`
92	- story mentions *after upgrading* -> `RC-16` (see the version rules)
93	- story mentions *last row* -> `RC-02`
94	
95	**ValueError**
96	
97	- story mentions *decimal* -> `RC-06`
98	- story mentions *midnight* -> `RC-12`
99	- story mentions *pasted* -> `RC-19`
100	
101	**OSError**
102	
103	- story mentions *backslashes* -> `RC-09`
104	- story mentions *long session* -> `RC-10`
105	- story mentions *two jobs* -> `RC-03`
106	
107	**PermissionError**
108	
109	- story mentions *service account* -> `RC-14`
110	- story mentions *still open* -> `RC-03`
111	
112	**MemoryError**
113	
114	- story mentions *large export* -> `RC-15`
115	- story mentions *same input* -> `RC-10`
116	
117	**RuntimeError**
118	
119	- story mentions *both waiting* -> `RC-18`
120	- story mentions *after upgrading* -> `RC-16` (see the version rules)
121	- story mentions *while iterating* -> `RC-03`
122	
123	**ZeroDivisionError**
124	
125	- story mentions *empty result* -> `RC-17`
126	- story mentions *rounds to zero* -> `RC-06`
127	
128	**UnicodeDecodeError**
129	
130	- story mentions *Latin-1* -> `RC-08`
131	- story mentions *web form* -> `RC-19`
132	
133	**LookupError**
134	
135	- story mentions *no longer exists* -> `RC-04`
136	- story mentions *rebuild* -> `RC-11`
137	
138	**IndexError**
139	
140	- story mentions *last row* -> `RC-02`
141	- story mentions *empty selection* -> `RC-19`
142	
143	**AttributeError**
144	
145	- story mentions *no owner* -> `RC-01`
146	- story mentions *after upgrading* -> `RC-16` (see the version rules)
147	
148	**FileNotFoundError**
149	
150	- story mentions *backslashes* -> `RC-09`
151	- story mentions *no longer exists* -> `RC-04`
152	- story mentions *two jobs* -> `RC-03`
153	
154	Version rules (they replace the root cause from the table above):
155	
156	- `lattice.net.*` frame on 3.1.x, story says *after upgrading* -> `RC-13` (the HTTP client upgrade).
157	- `lattice.store.*` frame on 3.2.x, whatever the story -> `RC-05` (the storage engine swap).
158	- `lattice.core.*` frame on 3.3.x, whatever the story -> `RC-04` (the key move).
159	
160	## How to decide a fresh report
161	
162	- Read the top frame of the stacktrace: its module names the component.
163	- Find the exception block above and match the Actual section to one of its cues.
164	- Apply the version rules when the frame family and the version series both match.
165	- The operating system, host names, caller line numbers, the patch digit of the version, how
166	  often it happens and the wording carry no information.
167	
168	## Validation (when is a history record the same bug?)
169	
170	A history record can only be the same bug when `exception`, `top_frame` and the version series
171	match after normalisation: `lattice.net.http.fetch` and `lattice/net/http.py::fetch` are one frame
172	(line numbers are not part of it), and `3.1.2`, `v3.1.4` and `3.1.0` are all series `3.1`.
173	Matching fields are necessary, not sufficient: the same exception in the same frame on the same
174	series with a different story is a different bug with a different root cause.
175	
176	## Output
177	
178	Write `answer.json` in this directory:
179	
180	```json
181	{"component": "networking", "root_cause": "RC-13"}
182	```
183	
184	Ids are case-insensitive and `RC-7` equals `RC-07`. Component names are lower-case, with hyphens
185	where a name has spaces. Extra keys are ignored.
186	
187	## Rules
188	
189	- Do not modify `history.jsonl` or `task.json`; write nothing except `answer.json`.
190	- Only `answer.json` is graded. Your final message is not.

4	  "exception": "ZeroDivisionError",
5	  "top_frame": "lattice.report.summary.total",
6	  "version": "v3.3.5",
7	  "title": "ZeroDivisionError while sending a scheduled report (summary.total)",
8	  "body": "Environment

Running Lattice 3.3.5 on Debian 12 against ap-south-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
* Start by sending a scheduled report.
* Use values that are fractions of a cent.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

Expected

As on every earlier run, sending a scheduled report should
just complete.

Actual

When the total rounds to zero the division fails. Values
smaller than a cent get rounded to zero first.

Frequency

It occurs on about half the runs.",
9	  "stacktrace": "lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:63 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:143 in build
lattice/report/summary.py:103 in total
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero",
10	  "reported": "2026-01-05"
11	}
